districtFact: Catawba County has three public school systems for the 2026–27 school year. This record covers Catawba County Schools, not Hickory City Schools or Newton-Conover City Schools.

about.title: Which CCS Calendar Should You Use?
about.content: Most Catawba County Schools students follow the Traditional Calendar. Challenger Early College High School publishes a separate calendar, and the other two public school systems in Catawba County use their own district calendars.

planningTips.title: Planning Notes
content: Confirm that your student attends Catawba County Schools rather than Hickory City Schools or Newton-Conover City Schools.
Challenger Early College High School families should use the separate Challenger calendar.
Recheck the official district calendar after weather closures because designated make-up dates may change.

districtFaqs.q: Which Catawba County Schools calendar does this page cover?
districtFaqs.a: This page covers the district's Traditional Calendar. Challenger Early College High School follows a separate calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Does this calendar apply to every public school in Catawba County?
districtFaqs.a: No. Hickory City Schools and Newton-Conover City Schools operate separate calendars for the 2026–27 school year.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify CCS calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Check the official Catawba County Schools District Calendar page and announcements from your child's school.
